pages.title: Shared: private links
pages.one: Share a file by link. For files, the server never sees what is in it.

steps.detail: Only the locked copy goes to the server.

steps.text: Keeps it for 7 days (1 to 90, or for good)
The visitor's browser unlocks it with the key inside the link
steps.detail: The key part of the link never reaches the server.

steps.text: Deletes it when it runs out

good: Small web apps go online too: the server tests and starts the new version and keeps the old one running if it fails. Apps are not locked: they are private by link unless the admin allows public ones.
